import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print("NO")
        return
    
    p = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    r = int(data[2])
    
    idx = 3
    arr1 = list(map(int, data[idx:idx + p])) if p > 0 else []
    idx += p
    arr2 = list(map(int, data[idx:idx + q])) if q > 0 else []
    idx += q
    arr3 = list(map(int, data[idx:idx + r])) if r > 0 else []
    
    set1 = set(arr1)
    set2 = set(arr2)
    set3 = set(arr3)
    
    # Check all pairwise subset relations
    if (set1 <= set2) or (set2 <= set1) or \
       (set1 <= set3) or (set3 <= set1) or \
       (set2 <= set3) or (set3 <= set2):
        print("YES")
    else:
        print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
